description_en: After enabling public network access for a Bastionhost instance, you can add IP addresses to a whitelist to control access
description_zh: 堡垒机实例开启公网访问后，可以将指定公网IP地址加入白名单，允许公网流量访问堡垒机实例
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost config-instance-white-list --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --white-list 10.162.XX.XX,192.168.XX.XX --white-list-policies Entry=10.162.XX.XX,192.168.XX.XX Description=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigInstanceWhiteList
